'''Dekk Vizla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of [[Clan Vizla]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Iron" />

He was sent by [[Lane Vizla]] to investigate rumours of a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|basilisk war droid]] laboratory on [[Ruhnuk]] along with [[Brun (Mandalorian)|Brun]] and [[Vath]], however the three of them ended up captured by [[Kur Ha'rangir]]. Thought to be dead, Lane sent the [[Alliance Commander]] to follow their tracks, however the commander eventually ended up rescuing the three of them and they made their way back to Lane.<ref name="Iron" />
